items.source: Add a serialization hint like JacksonCodecSupport.JSON_VIEW_HINT to customize how the body will be serialized.
items.translation: 添加一个序列化提示，例如JacksonCodecSupport.JSON_VIEW_HINT，以自定义如何序列化正文。

items.source:
The date should be specified as the number of milliseconds since
January 1, 1970 GMT.
items.translation: 日期应指定为自 1970 年 1 月 1 日 GMT 以来的毫秒数。

items.source: Manipulate this entity's headers with the given consumer. The headers provided to the consumer are "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing header values, remove values, or use any of the other HttpHeaders methods.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操作此实体的标头。提供给 Consumer 的标头为“live”，以便 Consumer 可用于 覆盖现有标头值、移除值，或使用任何其他 HttpHeaders 方法。

items.source: Manipulate this response's cookies with the given consumer. The cookies provided to the consumer are "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing cookies, remove cookies, or use any of the other MultiValueMap methods.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操作此响应的 Cookie。提供给 Consumer 的 Cookie 是“活动”的，因此该 Consumer 可用于 覆盖现有 Cookie、移除Cookie，或使用任何其他 MultiValueMap 方法。

items.source: Set the media type of the body, as specified by the Content-Type header.
items.translation: 设置正文的媒体类型，由`Content-Type` 标头指定。

items.source: Set the length of the body in bytes, as specified by the Content-Length header.
items.translation: 设置以 Content-Length 标头指定的字节数作为正文长度。

items.source: Set the entity tag of the body, as specified by the ETag header.
items.translation: 设置实体的标签，如ETag 头中指定。

items.source: Set the time the resource was last changed, as specified by the Last-Modified header.
items.translation: 设置资源上次更改的时间，由 Last-Modified 头指定。

items.source: Set the location of a resource, as specified by the Location header.
items.translation: 设置资源的位置，如由 Location 标头指定。

items.source: Build the response.
items.translation: 请提供需要翻译的英文技术文档内容，我将严格按照您的要求（仅翻译自然语言文本、保留所有代码/变量/HTML标签、不添加任何Markdown格式）输出中文译文。

items.source:
Configure one or more request header names (for example, "Accept-Language") to
add to the "Vary" response header to inform clients that the response is
subject to content negotiation and variances based on the value of the
given request headers.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个请求头名称（例如，"Accept-Language"），将其添加到"Vary"响应头中，以告知客户端响应受内容协商影响，且会根据给定请求头的值而变化。

items.source:
Configure one or more request header names (for example, "Accept-Language") to
add to the "Vary" response header to inform clients that the response is
subject to content negotiation and variances based on the value of the
given request headers. The configured request header names are added only
if not already present in the response "Vary" header.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个请求头名称（例如，"Accept-Language"），将其添加到响应头"Vary"中，以告知客户端响应受内容协商影响，且会根据给定请求头的值而变化。如果响应头"Vary"中尚未存在这些配置的请求头名称，则仅添加它们。
